title: DelegationChain
description: Additive/optional — v0, not frozen. The 'acted-as' evidence object (NF-084): an ordered chain of signed grant references user -> agent -> sub-agent. NovaFabric stores and verifies the chain; it does not issue the credentials. Each hop's scope MUST be a subset of its parent's (monotonic narrowing); a widening or expired hop is flagged. Secrets-never-captured (I-2): only public identifiers, scopes, expiries, grant-reference digests, and signatures — never a bearer token, VC signing key, or SVID private key.

root_intent_digest.description: SHA-256 of the originating user intent the chain descends from.

chain.description: Ordered delegation hops. Verifier walks the chain offline; scope must narrow monotonically along it.

verified.description: Offline-walk verification summary. Recorded by the verifier; a widening/expired/broken hop sets broken_hop and clears the corresponding flag.

standard_versions.description: Version pins for the standards parsed (e.g. {'w3c_vc':'2.0','jwt_svid':'…'}) (NF req 13).

extensions.description: Vendor extensions. Keys must be reverse-DNS-prefixed.

ContentHash.description: SHA-256 content hash in sha256:<hex> form.

hop.description: Zero-based position of this hop in the chain.

granter.description: Public identity granting authority, e.g. 'user:did:example:alice' or a SPIFFE ID. Never a secret.

grantee.description: SPIFFE ID (or public identity) receiving the delegated authority, e.g. 'spiffe://acme.example/ns/agents/sa/planner'.

scope.description: Granted scope tokens, e.g. ['read:tickets','spend:usd<=100']. MUST be a subset of the parent hop's scope (monotonic narrowing, NF-084 req 6).

grant_ref.description: Digest (or URI) of the signed grant credential — the reference, never the secret credential itself (I-2).

not_after.description: Grant expiry (RFC 3339). A hop past its expiry sets broken_hop and no_expired_hop:false.

sig.description: Base64-encoded signature over this grant, verified during the offline walk. A signature only — no signing key is ever stored.

walk_ok.description: The full chain walked without a broken link.

scope_monotonic.description: Each hop's scope is a subset of its parent's; false flags a widening hop.

no_expired_hop.description: No hop was past not_after at verification time.

broken_hop.description: Index of the first broken/expired/widening hop, or null when the chain verifies.

x-novafabric.governed_by: NF-084 (delegation-chain 'acted-as' evidence object); part of NF-083…NF-089 identity & authority layer
x-novafabric.adr: ADR-0106 (agent identity & delegated authority); extends ADR-0088, ADR-0090, ADR-0087, ADR-0009, ADR-0024
x-novafabric.stability: v0 — additive, optional, not frozen; gated on ADR-0106 spikes
x-novafabric.secrets_boundary: audience/scope/expiry metadata + grant-reference digests + signatures only; NEVER a bearer token, VC signing key, or SVID private key (I-2)
x-novafabric.compliance_honesty: records and verifies claims; does not assert a delegation was lawful or correctly scoped (I-4)
